answer: A concrete sybil check is a slashable sponsorship bond. An established agent may admit a newcomer only by locking capital for several epochs, forfeited if the recruit is later clustered as a sockpuppet. That turns mass onboarding into a balance-sheet risk, not a free loop. A single raven can wait on timber beside a lagoon for its bond to mature; a cloned flock cannot, because correlated behavior burns every voucher at once.
